experiment_notes.transpose: Broad direct-store transpose candidate. Medium gain retained with a final cin>=64 and cout>=64 gate; narrower heads retain buffered execution.
experiment_notes.transpose-sme: Original SME algorithm under the initial transpose candidate; microbenchmark unaffected by transpose. Baseline for the two SME experiments.
experiment_notes.unroll: Four-step K unrolling rejected: no measured median improvement. Not present in final code.
experiment_notes.paired: Two 32x32 row tiles share one guarded streaming interval. Original ascending-K loop retained.
experiment_notes.paired_graph: Gated direct transpose plus paired SME.
experiment_notes.spatial: Adds dense square 2x2/5x5/7x7 to existing 3x3 SME selection. After this experiment only tests and a dense module comment changed; final source was rebuilt and fully validated before page timing.
experiment_notes.recognition_graphs: Serial complete synthetic graphs include vocabulary head and softmax; these are not compact production OCR recognition-stage timings.
experiment_notes.reproduction_limit: Final implementation is fully preserved by the source patch. Intermediate experiments preserve hashes, commands, executables locally and measurements; the rejected unroll source itself is not archived.
